title: Buddy rebuild — two things to confirm before the sign-off list

steps.path: Every message in the buddy chat
steps.headline: Message times show only on the newest message; on any other, rest the pointer on it for half a second to see its time.
steps.changed: This is what round 2 showed; your note there was about text sitting close to the bubble edge, which round 3 fixed, so the times themselves were never confirmed.
steps.notice: Less clutter between messages; the newest still says when it arrived.
steps.risk: Checking an older message's time takes a short hover.

steps.path: When Claude asks permission to run something
steps.headline: A permission request in the buddy is one line saying what Claude wants to run, with Yes and No under it.
steps.changed: This is the main window's own permission card; it was already this small in the buddy, so it is unchanged. The decks only ever showed the question card, which is now one question at a time.
steps.notice: You allow or refuse without scrolling. Pressing the line opens the full command first if you want to read it.
steps.risk: A long command shows only its beginning until you open it.
